newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel sees 2.72 bln ffr 1997 loss.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel sees 2.72 bln ffr 1997 loss.

text.p: Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA/Plc executive chairman Patrick Ponsolle said on Thursday the company expects to post a net loss of 2.719 billion francs ($456.2 million) in 1997 compared with a net loss of 6.1 billion francs in 1996.
Ponsolle told an extraordinary shareholders' meeting, being held for a vote on a debt restructuring plan, that the net loss would fall by "more than 50 percent".

The improvement in the results would stem from lower interest charges of 3.233 billion francs, compared to interest paid in 1996 of 5.7 billion, assuming its debt restructuring plan was approved, he said.
Eurotunnel's operating result was forecast to rise to 514 million francs compared with 297 million last year, he said.
